patch_coordinate_rule: Group all rows by exact patch_number. Require finite latitude/longitude for every row and no other analysis columns. For each patch, define latitude as the arithmetic mean of all pixel_latitude values and longitude as the arithmetic mean of all pixel_longitude values. This response-independent Landsat-pixel centroid rule is frozen before geometry bytes are opened.
node_identity_rule: Node ID is the exact patch_number string after outer-whitespace stripping only; no aliases, numeric coercion, fuzzy matching, or response-derived filtering.
system_metadata_only_next: retrieve DataONE system metadata/checksum/size for this exact data PID; if identity is public and stable, then retrieve this geometry object only and run the frozen structural gate
response_boundary: Do not access the semi-annual biomass/fecundity response package or any response rows in this geometry stage.
